book_verdict: The most faithful of the four. It marks the obscured initials and the overwritten words on folio 9 as <unclear> instead of guessing ('graue' fits the visible strokes and the metre). Its acrostic note on folio 37 (I F I C I Q S Q T N S) matches the margin.
